newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Oct-Dec indust output seen up 3.4% q/q -- MITI.
newsitem.headline: Japan Oct-Dec indust output seen up 3.4% q/q -- MITI.

text.p: Japan's Trade Ministry forecast on Tuesday that the country's industrial output for the October to December period would rise by 3.4 percent against the previous quarter.
The ministry had earlier forecast a rise of 3.1 percent over the period.
A ministry official said Japan's industrial production was on a gradually rising trend and this had been confirmed by revised data for November.
MITI said earlier that industrial output in November fell a revised 1.4 percent against the previous month. This compared with a preliminary estimate of a 1.9 percent fall.
The official said the difference was due to a rise in production of medical goods and mobile-phone related equipment.
